About Us

Chtrbox is a 360° marketing agency that offers unique blend of creative services merging data and strategy.

Chtrbox builds impactful influencer marketing campaigns, social-first growth strategies and also manages an exclusive roster of creators. Whether it’s nano creators, campus ambassadors, or top influencers, we connect brands with the right voices to drive real conversations and measurable impact.

What's Our Magic Sauce?

Data-Powered Influencer Strategy

Our teams are experts in thinking holistically about influencer marketing strategy and digital content, from social media integrations to influencer-led IPs.

India's Biggest Influencer Marketing Network
